notes.title: Save File disappearing??
notes.notes:
For people who downloaded the game in the last few hours, you may notice your save file has disappeared. 


If you want to get it back do this; 

- Open Windows Registry Editor (regedit) from the start menu
- Find \HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\PinkTea\ 
- Rename the ‘Elven Conquest 1.0.3’ folder as 'EC1‘



Sorry for the trouble
